Kitchen Assistant – Part-Time / Full-Time

Maharaja Indian Restaurant – Østerbro, Copenhagen

Maharaja Indian Restaurant is looking for a reliable and motivated Kitchen Assistant to join our team in Copenhagen.

We are a well-established Indian restaurant with a strong focus on authentic Indian cuisine, quality ingredients and professional kitchen operations.

Your Responsibilities

• 
Assisting chefs with daily food preparation.

• 
Assisting with Indian bread preparation and other traditional dishes.

•

Reliable, punctual and responsible.

Car Mechanic (Automekaniker) – Au2vest ApS

Company: Au2vest ApS
CVR no.: 37874299
Position: Car Mechanic (3 positions)
Employment: Full-time, permanent
Work location: Rugvænget 33, 2630 Taastrup
Start date: As soon as possible

About Au2vest ApS

Au2vest ApS is a complete car business with an approved auto workshop, car sales, auto painting and repair of insurance damage. We have more than 15 years of experience and work on all car makes, including electric and hybrid cars. Quality, safety and personal service come first in everything we do.

We are now looking for 3 skilled and reliable car mechanics for our workshop.

Your tasks

• 
Service and repair of all car makes and models according to manufacturer specifications

• 
Fault finding and diagnostics using modern diagnostic equipment

• 
Repair of engines, brakes, timing belts, suspension and exhaust systems

• 
Air conditioning service and tyre changes

• 
Inspection of used cars before sale

• 
Service of electric and hybrid cars

• 
Keeping tools and the workshop tidy and following safety rules

We are looking for

• 
Documented professional experience as a car mechanic

• 
Good knowledge of modern cars, diagnostics and repair

• 
Ability to work independently and accurately, and to take responsibility for your work

• 
Good working habits, reliability and motivation for long-term employment

• 
English or Danish at a level where you can work with colleagues and instructions

We offer

• 
Full-time, permanent employment

• 
Salary and employment conditions in line with Danish standards

• 
A stable workplace with long-term prospects

• 
A professional and well-equipped workplace with skilled colleagues

• 
Varied work on many different car makes and models

How to apply – please read carefully

We only review complete applications from serious candidates who have real, documented experience.

Send your application by email to: jobs@au2vest.dk

Write the position you are applying for in the subject line of your email: Car Mechanic

Your application must include:

• 
An updated CV showing your work history with dates, employers and job titles

• 
Documentation of your previous experience, such as employment contracts, employment certificates or reference letters

• 
Declarations or statements from previous employers confirming your work

• 
Educational diplomas, trade certificates or course certificates, if you have them

• 
Payslips from previous jobs, if you have them

• 
A short written application explaining why you are the right person for the job

All documents must be sent as PDF files attached to the same email. Documents in a language other than Danish or English should be sent with a translation.

Applications without documentation, applications without the position in the subject line and applications sent any other way will not be considered. Please do not call the company or write on social media.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and suitable candidates will be invited to an interview. Please apply as soon as possible.

Do you have forklift experience? Join Brødrene A&O Johansen in Horsens for outdoor forklift work. Full-time position with immediate start!

You will work with larger forklifts and heavy goods at a large outdoor warehouse covering approximately 100,000 m². It's a great opportunity to build on your forklift experience, learn to use new equipment and become part of a great team.

You don't need experience with the specific types of forklifts used at the warehouse. What matters most is that you have practical forklift experience and are ready to take on new tasks.

Your Responsibilities

• 
Operating large forklifts and handling heavy goods

• 
Loading and unloading trucks and trailers

• 
Picking, packing and preparing orders

To be considered for the position, you must have a valid forklift certificate and be comfortable working outdoors.

Working hours (full-time): Monday to Thursday from 11:00 to 19:00 and Friday from 11:00 to 18:30.

Salary: DKK 180.71 per hour, including fixed allowances

• 
Additional 10% flexible benefits contribution (Fritvalgskonto) and pension

Additional evening allowance for hours worked after 18:00

Are you motivated by building and operating robust, secure, and scalable IT infrastructure in a business where reliability and performance matter? Do you enjoy working hands-on with modern cloud platforms while ensuring stability, security, and efficiency across the organization?

We are looking for an IT Infrastructure Specialist to take ownership of our cloud-based IT environment. In this role, you will not only to operate and improve our infrastructure, but also to make technical decisions and drive direction within your domain.

You will play a key role in ensuring smooth day-to-day operations while continuously improving our infrastructure to support a growing and demanding business. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization as part of a small, focused IT team where ownership, execution, and continuous improvement are central.

This is a broad role with the opportunity to work across multiple areas of IT infrastructure. We’re looking for someone with a solid foundation, a curious mindset, and the drive to continuously develop both our environment and your own expertise.

Your responsibilities will include

• Operate our cloud-only IT infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, and security

• Administer and optimize our Microsoft 365 environment (including Entra ID and Intune)

• Manage endpoints, identities, and access controls across the organization

• Design, implement, and maintain networking solutions (e.g. cloud networking, firewalls, VPN)

• Monitor systems and respond to incidents, including security and operational events

• Implement and maintain security controls, policies, and procedures, ensuring alignment with standards (e.g. NIS2, NIST, GDPR)

• Automate and standardize infrastructure and operational processes

• Collaborate with teams across the business to ensure IT supports evolving needs

• Drive continuous improvement of infrastructure, tooling, and ways of working

• Provide day-to-day IT operations and end-user support, including walk-up support and troubleshooting

What we’re looking for

• Experience working with cloud-based infrastructure (Azure) in a hands-on role

• Ability and willingness to take ownership and make technical decisions independently

• Strong understanding of identity and access management (Entra ID or similar)

• Experience managing endpoints and device policies (e.g. Intune or similar tools)

• Solid knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, routing, firewalls, VPNs, segmentation) and experience implementing them in a cloud environment

• Practical experience with security operations (incident handling, hardening, monitoring, access control)

• Experience with Microsoft 365 administration

• Ability to automate tasks and workflows (e.g. PowerShell, scripting, or similar)

• Understanding of compliance and security frameworks (e.g. NIST, NIS2, ISO 27001, GDPR)

It would be an advantage if you also have

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code or configuration management

• Experience setting up and managing monitoring, alerts, and logging systems

• Experience working in a small team with broad responsibility

• Exposure to environments where uptime and reliability are business-critical

What we offer

• A young, ambitious, and fun working environment

• A steep learning curve and early responsibility

• Close collaboration with skilled developers, traders, and analysts

• The opportunity to work on business-critical systems with real impact

• Brand-new office in the heart of Aarhus, right by Dokk1

• A fun and social work environment with regular team events and social activities throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to strengthen team spirit, including our Nitor running club.

• Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen

• Competitive salary package

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is transforming its existing client base to SimCorp One, our flagship enterprise platform for the world’s largest investment managers. SaaS is the foundation that makes this transformation scalable, resilient and commercially compelling.

As Sales Director, SaaS, you will sit at the centre of this growth mission. You will join a global specialist SWAT team working with regional Sales and Customer Success teams to move clients from on-premise deployments to SaaS-based SimCorp One. This is a client-facing, quota-carrying role with real ownership: from the first executive conversation and business case through solution shaping, commercial negotiation and signature.

You will help clients make one of their most important technology and operating-model decisions, while directly contributing to SimCorp’s global SaaS growth and the successful adoption of SimCorp One.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**Own complex SaaS transformation sales

• Lead the SaaS commercial motion for selected existing clients across EMEA, in close partnership with regional Sales and Customer Success teams.

• Own qualified opportunities from first client engagement through discovery, business case, proposal, negotiation and signature.

• Translate each client’s business, operating-model and technology priorities into a credible SaaS transformation roadmap and commercial proposition.

• Carry and deliver a multi-million-euro ARR target, maintaining clear opportunity strategy, forecast discipline and deal momentum.

Orchestrate the deal team

• Mobilise and lead virtual deal teams across Sales, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, Product, Platform, Services, Legal and Commercial Finance.

• Create clarity on roles, decisions, dependencies and next steps, ensuring complex sales processes progress with pace and quality.

• Engage confidently with C-level, technology, operations, procurement and risk stakeholders, adapting the value case to each audience.

• Lead commercial negotiations and internal governance, balancing client outcomes, speed and long-term value for SimCorp.

Accelerate the global SaaS growth engine

• Work as part of the specialist SimCorp One and SaaS SWAT team, sharing expertise and supporting priority transformations across markets.

• Partner with GTM, Marketing and regional leadership to identify the right clients, build pipeline and focus resources where conversion potential is strongest.

• Improve the SaaS pitch, value proposition and competitive positioning against alternatives such as remaining on-premise, running a client-owned cloud journey or full outsourcing.

• Capture field insight and feed it back into offer development, pricing, contracting, product roadmap, sales materials and enablement.

Build market confidence and repeatability

• Act as a visible SaaS thought leader internally and externally, making complex cloud and operating-model topics commercially relevant and easy to understand.

• Use standard sales plays, artefacts and governance while adapting the client journey to market maturity, installed landscape and transformation readiness.

• Create reusable deal patterns and lessons that improve conversion, consistency and scale across EMEA.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

• 10+ years of experience in enterprise software, cloud, managed services, financial technology or a comparable complex solution-sales environment.

• Proven record of winning large, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals and meeting or exceeding multi-million-euro ARR targets.

• Strong commercial understanding of public cloud, SaaS, enterprise technology and recurring-revenue business models.

• Experience selling transformation rather than a standalone product, including the ability to build an executive business case and navigate long decision cycles.

• Good understanding of financial services and preferably the buy-side investment management industry.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional deal teams without formal authority and to create momentum in a global matrix organisation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Additional European languages are an advantage, preferably German

• Relevant higher education in business, economics, technology, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Capabilities and working style

• Commercial owner: You take accountability for the outcome, keep the client and internal team aligned, and move decisively from interest to commitment.

• Executive seller: You create trust with senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and connect technology choices to measurable business value.

• Deal orchestrator: You bring the right experts together, simplify complexity and maintain clear governance across large virtual teams.

• Transformation mindset: You understand that a move to SaaS changes technology, operations, risk, economics and ways of working, and you can lead clients through that change.

• Builder and collaborator: You improve the sales motion while executing it, sharing insight freely and contributing to one global SaaS growth mission.

• Disciplined and curious: You combine rigorous forecasting and deal management with the curiosity to understand each client’s context and identify a path forward.

• AI-enabled: You use AI tools responsibly to research, prepare, synthesise and scale high-quality commercial work.

**Benefits

**Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more.

In addition to our traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance through flexible working arrangements and a hybrid workplace model.

We are committed to supporting continuous professional growth through training, knowledge sharing, leadership exposure, and opportunities to work with some of the most sophisticated organizations in the global investment management industry.

There is never just one route for development at SimCorp. We offer an individual approach to career development and encourage employees to pursue paths aligned with their ambitions and interests.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an Incident Manager to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response domain.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 440 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an Incident Manager who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.

CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)

Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in the Nordics. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.

The Role

As a Cyber Incident Manager, you are responsible for coordinating incident engagements from initial response through containment, forensic investigation, recovery, and post-incident activities.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams consisting of forensic investigators, recovery specialists, infrastructure experts, legal advisors, and customer stakeholders. At the same time, you will act as a trusted advisor to customer representatives throughout the incident lifecycle.

Your focus will be on driving progress, aligning priorities, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring that response and recovery activities move forward efficiently. You will gradually be taking on increasing responsibility as you develop your leadership, stakeholder management, customer advisory, and crisis coordination capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate cybersecurity incident response engagements.

• Act as a primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders during incidents.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams consisting of technical and business specialists.

• Drive recovery efforts to minimize business disruption and downtime.

• Provide guidance and recommendations throughout the incident lifecycle.

• Support customers in strengthening resilience and preparedness after incidents.

• Contribute to the continuous development of Truesec incident response capabilities and methodologies.

Your Potential Background

We believe you have a background in cyber security, IT operations, managed services, consulting, technical account management, service delivery, project coordination, or a similar field.

You enjoy collaborating with both technical specialists and business stakeholders, bringing structure to challenging situations and helping teams to prioritize the work toward a common goal.

Required Skills

• Understanding how modern IT environments and services are operated and supported.

• Experience leading major incidents, service disruptions, or crisis situations.

• Experience advising senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

• Ability to build trusted relationships with technical specialists and business stakeholders.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic mindset.

• Professional proficiency in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience

• Experience within cybersecurity incident response, digital forensics, SOC operations, or managed security services.

• Understanding of compliance, regulatory, legal, and information protection requirements.

• Background in consulting or customer-facing advisory roles.

• Experience with cloud security and hybrid IT environments.

• Knowledge of cyber risk management, business continuity, and resilience.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship or citizenship in another EU country. Language skills in English and Danish is required.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

GUBI is a modern design company offering a wide variety of luxury furniture, lighting, and interior objects for both residential and commercial settings. With a strong global presence, GUBI’s headquarters and showroom are located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About the position

Do you have a good eye for design, interiors and photography, and an interest in how a design house collaborates with creative voices? As GUBI’s Creative Partnerships & Social Intern, you’ll help build two new programmes from the start. One is a creative partnerships programme with photographers, stylists, writers and storytellers whose perspective brings something new to the conversation around design. The other is an affiliate programme with creators across Europe. You’ll work closely with the programme lead and collaborate with colleagues across Marketing and E-commerce, helping keep collaborations running smoothly from first contact to published content.

Key responsibilities

• Support outreach to new creators and partners and help onboard them into the affiliate programme, including preparing agreements and briefs.

• Coordinate gifting and product seeding, from approval through stock checks, shipping and follow-up.

• Support the content calendar and our social channels, and bring your own ideas to the table.

• Help create briefs for creative collaborations and attend shoots when they take place in Copenhagen.

• Maintain an overview of product shipments, content received and partnership deliverables.

• Support the preparation of monthly reports on reach, engagement and affiliate sales.

Qualifications

• A good eye for design, interiors and photography, with solid design knowledge and references.

• Experience with Notion, Figma and social platforms is an advantage.

Language skills

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Personal attributes

• Organised and very detail-oriented, with a structured approach to tasks.

• Proactive in following up to keep collaborations moving, and willing to ask questions along the way.

• Comfortable managing several tasks at once and adapting when priorities change.

• Curious, open-minded and collaborative.

For our customer Deloitte, we are looking for a Software Engineer/Architects. With more than 3000 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. They tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services and Consulting.

About the team

The Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation are on the lookout for additional team-players for their practice of 80+ software engineers, (cloud) architects, cloud strategists, and IT management consultants. The team assists some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new IT systems as part of their digital transformation – and you can help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together you will be able to accelerate your career as a developer. At Deloitte, they are committed to empowering you throughout your career development. As a new employee, you are assigned a talent manager to support your career aspirations and development. You will also be part of a tech community with monthly meetings in which we share knowledge, investigate new topics, and upskill within relevant technologies and methodologies.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Consulting is second to none. They offer everything from various sports communities to internal hackathons – not to forget the yearly Consulting Trip where all our colleagues get together off-site to create life lasting memories.

Job Description

As a Developer, you will be part of the technical teams through the entire development process—from requirements specification and architecture to implementation and testing. You will work closely with both clients and internal stakeholders to ensure that our solutions meet their business needs and technical requirements.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development, often directed towards public clouds or on-premises.

• Assisting in the implementation of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (IaC), and adopting DevOps practices to streamline development workflows.

• Assisting in designing and communicating architectural overviews such as target architecture and solution architecture

• Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.

• Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

What you bring to the team:

• A master’s degree within IT, Engineering or similar

• 2-10 years experience as a software engineer/architect.

• Strong technical knowledge in Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, or one or more other widely used programming languages.

• Preferably experience with at least one of the major cloud providers (Azure, AWS or GCP)

• High proficiency in written and spoken English and are either a native Danish speaker or possess a high proficiency in written and spoken Danish.

• It will be a big advantage if you have previous consulting experience

• Experience with modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and test automation.

• You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.

We aim to fill the position as soon as possible and will evaluate applications as they arrive.

You can learn more about Deloitte here:

Your role

This is not a pure channel management role. You will own how we acquire users and merchants, from the first ad impression to the first cashback earned.

We are looking for a hands-on marketing specialist who combines deep paid media skills with a structured, test-driven mindset. You care about clicks and installs, but more about activated users who stay, shop and earn. You set up the experiments, read the data and make the call.

You report to our Chief Growth Officer and play a central role in scaling Loyalty Key across the Nordics. You get real budget, real ownership and short decision paths.

Working at Loyalty Key

Loyalty Key is building the Nordic standard for payment-linked loyalty. Our technology turns everyday card payments into automatic rewards: no coupons, no points, no receipts. Just cashback, straight to the consumer, every time they shop with a partner.

We power loyalty for some of the region's strongest brands, including Visa, Danske Bank and SAS EuroBonus, and connect consumers with more than 2,000 merchants. Our own consumer app, Cashback med Visa, puts that network directly in people's pockets.

We are a Copenhagen-based team with an ambitious plan: to make card-linked cashback something every Nordic cardholder uses, and every merchant wants to be part of.

What you will own

Your main focus is consumer growth: getting the right people to download the app, sign up and start earning. You will also drive lead generation towards merchants who want to join our network.

Performance roadmap

• 
Own the paid acquisition roadmap across channels and markets

• 
Identify what limits growth today, and prioritize the work that moves the needle

• 
Balance volume, user quality and cost, and make those trade-offs visible

Paid acquisition

• 
Run and scale campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, TikTok and Snapchat

• 
Drive app user acquisition through programmatic and mobile DSP partners

• 
Manage budgets, pacing and channel allocation

Creative and messaging

• 
Build a structured creative testing framework: hypothesis, variant, iteration

• 
Brief designers, UGC creators and agency partners with clear, data-backed direction

• 
Find the hooks, offers and merchant stories that turn attention into signups

Landing pages and conversion

• 
Own conversion beyond the ad click: landing pages, app store listings and signup flows

• 
Run A/B tests on pages, offers and onboarding steps

• 
Optimize for activated users, not just installs

Agency and partner management

• 
Lead our external performance agency with clear goals and accountability for results

• 
Work with DSP and media partners on setup, performance and reporting

• 
Contribute to joint campaigns with brand partners such as Visa

B2B lead generation

• 
Run lead campaigns towards merchants and hand qualified leads to our sales team

• 
Follow the full path from lead to meeting to signed merchant, and optimize for quality

What you'll bring

We are looking for an experienced performance marketing specialist: deep in paid acquisition, broad enough to improve the whole funnel around it.

Essential

• 
3–5 years of experience in performance or growth marketing, in-house or agency side

• 
Deep hands-on expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads

• 
Proven experience with at least one of TikTok, Snapchat or programmatic / mobile DSP

• 
A track record of structured creative testing, with results you can point to

• 
Hands-on experience with landing page optimization and A/B testing

• 
Strong analytical skills: you build your own reports and let data drive decisions

• 
Experience leading agencies or media partners towards commercial goals

• 
High ownership and a bias for action: you get things live and iterate

• 
Fluent English, written and spoken

Strongly preferred

• 
App marketing experience, including mobile attribution tools such as Adjust or AppsFlyer

• 
A background in fintech, loyalty, e-commerce or consumer apps

• 
B2B lead generation experience, ideally with HubSpot or a similar CRM

• 
Experience running campaigns across several markets

Competitive salary

Do you like testing complex systems and working closely with developers? We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join our Product Extension Team in Copenhagen. You will bring senior test expertise to a small team that builds integrations and extensions for Systematic's defence products, with real influence on how we test and improve.

The job

As the team's senior tester, you will be its quality advocate, driving how we test and improve across the full development lifecycle. You will combine hands-on test execution with real influence over our testing tools, methods and processes.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Planning, estimating and executing test activities, and contributing to test estimates in project planning

• Driving quality across the development lifecycle through risk-based test design

• Developing and maintaining system-level automated tests that support feature testing

• Challenging developers and projects on where automation makes the most sense, including weak points in developer-driven tests

• Improving our test tools, methods and processes

You should expect occasional travel of around five to ten days a year, mostly within Europe. Some onsite hardware testing may also be required, depending on integration needs.

Joining the team

What You Will Bring

Ready to apply?

jobs.occupation: Project lead (strain engineering for client delivery)
jobs.description:
Enduro Genetics is a world-leading biotech at the interface of synthetic biology and biomanufacturing. Our platform product Enduro Sense is a transformative gene technology that redefines the capabilities of cells in fermentation. Enduro Sense is used for cell-based expression systems and production strains to deliver higher titer, rate and yields, making biomanufacturing more efficient and scalable.

As we expand to meet growing client demands, we are seeking a results-driven and people-oriented Project Lead to oversee our microbial strain engineering projects with clients.

Who You Are:

This role is perfect for a senior science leader passionate about leveraging synthetic biology to create tangible biomanfacturing step-ups for clients while fostering team growth and motivation. You thrive in fast-paced settings, communicate clearly and are eager to join a rapidly scaling company, currently around 25 employees.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and mentor high-performing R&D teams to drive project success.

• Develop and implement research strategies to meet key milestones.

• Oversee client projects to ensure timely progress and impactful results.

• Collaborate with scientists and stakeholders of all levels to deliver on project timelines and deliverables.

• Provide expert technical guidance to support project outcomes.

What You Bring:

• Education: PhD in Synthetic Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline.

• Industry Experience: 7+ years in microbial strain engineering, with corporate expertise in pharmaceutical or industrial bioprocesses.

• Technical Expertise:

• Strong background in production strain technology, recombinant protein expression, or metabolite production.

• Proven track-record in developing microbial strains for bioprocesses.

• Leadership: Exceptional project management skills, including team mentorship and development.

• Analytical and Communication: Ability to solve complex problems and communicate effectively incl. in written and oral presentations.

• Adaptability: Capacity to excel in a dynamic, fast-growing organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience leading agile R&D teams.

• Technical strain engineering experience in Bacillus, E. coli, Corynebacterium or yeasts (Pichia, S. cerevisiae etc)

• Familiarity with corporate bioprocess development workflows.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), small-scale automation, and fermentation science.

• Background in pharmaceutical GMP environments.

• Relevant experience from e.g. a CDMO or CRO on delivering projects with clients or collaboration partners

Why Join Enduro Genetics?

At Enduro, you'll play a vital role roling out our technology to leading clients, shaping the future of biomanufacturing. Be part of a collaborative and innovative environment where your contributions make a difference.

If you're ready to advance your career in industrial biotechnology and lead impactful projects, apply now to join our team.

Applications will be screened regularly

jobs.occupation: Event & Experience Manager – Bring Axlab’s customer experiences to life
jobs.description:
Can you turn a showroom visit, a reference site tour or an industry exhibition into an experience that makes a lasting impression?

In collaboration with Actief Hartmanns, Axlab is looking for an Event & Experience Manager who combines creative design with hands-on delivery and a clear commercial focus.

In the position you will own Axlab’s customer-facing experience programme: reference site visits, the headquarters showroom, Axlab Academy, and industry exhibitions. This is an opportunity to combine concept development with practical execution, shaping how visitors experience Axlab’s solutions and building the calendar, materials and processes that ensure consistent quality and continuity.

Your role goes beyond logistics: you will design welcoming, relevant experiences that help visitors understand how Axlab’s solutions work in practice. You will also build the calendar, materials and documented processes that make the programme consistent, scalable, and less dependent on any one individual.

You will be part of the Marcom team and work closely with Sales, Product Management, and external partners. Together with the Graphic Designer & Event Coordinator, you will translate ideas into a strong exhibition presence and cohesive creative execution.

What you will take ownership of

• 
Develop and deliver reference site visits, showroom tours, Academy days and exhibitions that connect customer needs with Axlab’s automated pathology workflows.

• 
Establish and continually improve the showroom experience and reference site concept for prospective and existing customers.

• 
Manage programmes and events from concept to delivery, aligning internal teams, external agencies, and production partners.

• 
Build and maintain the activity calendar, supporting materials, briefings, and documented processes.

• 
Manage suppliers, budgets, and negotiations, with close attention to production details and on-site logistics.

• 
Track event performance and work with Sales and within Marcom to ensure effective lead handling and handover.

• 
Help support the development of a sustainable webinar approach that contributes to sales opportunities.

What you bring

You have at least five years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or customer experience, ideally combining large-scale exhibitions with smaller, hosted experiences. Exhibition or trade show experience is essential, together with relevant experience from the medical device industry. You can demonstrate that you have designed and delivered premium customer or partner experiences, not simply coordinated the logistics.

• 
A bachelor’s degree or higher in marketing, communications, business, hospitality, or event management, or equivalent experience.

• 
Experience establishing and improving a showroom for a company providing anatomic pathology equipment or a medical device company.

• 
Experience developing and refining reference site concepts for prospective and existing customers.

• 
Strong end-to-end project management skills and the ability to collaborate with Sales, Product Management, and external partners.

• 
Experience managing vendors, suppliers, and budgets, including negotiations with agencies and production partners.

• 
Confidence reporting on event performance, handling leads and coordinates their handover.

• 
Fluency in English. Danish is an advantage when working with headquarters and the local reference site network.

Experience developing a webinar strategy that generates sales opportunities is a plus. Alternatively, you are comfortable learning this skill quickly, as you will work closely with your future colleagues in Marcom on this.

Regular travel should be expected, and in busy periods, this can be 50% or more.

A thoughtful host with a hands-on mindset

You make people feel genuinely welcome and adapt naturally to different visitors and situations. You stay calm when plans change, take pride in the details and are just as comfortable shaping an experience concept as managing the on-site logistics. Open and approachable, you build trust with colleagues, suppliers and senior stakeholders, communicate clear briefs, and know who needs which information — and when.

You bring creativity, initiative and a collaborative approach. You are curious about what works, use data and feedback to improve the programme and look for ways to make each visit or event meaningful rather than routine.

Axlab’s Marcom team works to build recognition of the Axlab brand for bringing innovation and automation to pathology laboratories in its direct markets. Through consistent brand storytelling, impactful events, customer experiences and digital channels, the team connects colleagues and customers with that ambition. In this role, you will have ownership of the experiences that show what it means in practice.

What we offer

We are a small yet ambitious growth company where our shared values — Decency, Innovation, Commitment, and Responsibility — form the foundation of everything we do. We offer a flexible, hybrid, and trust-based full-time position where you will have influence on both your own role and the continued development of our Marcom function . Occasional travel activity must be expected as part of the role.

• 
Competitive salary and employment conditions

• 
A highly visible role with direct access to senior leadership

• 
Influence on business decisions and strategic initiatives

• 
Professional and personal development opportunities

• 
An international and collaborative working environment

• 
Welcoming and comfortable office space with everyday perks including free refreshments and daily lunch buffet

• 
Social activities and annual global events
